datasetVersion.termsOfAccess: Because the identity of respondents is traceable through background details, the data is restricted. If people want to check my work, they can access the data.

dsDescriptionValue.value: The dataset of the doctoral research of Kors Visscher. It contains the datapackage with transcripts of his interviews with active citizens. It contains 40 transcripts, a datamanagement plan, a description of the datapackage, a researchplan, the written information respondents received (in Dutch) and the informed consent form (in Dutch).

fields.value: While the interviews have been anonimized, the respondents can still be traced back to background information. This could not be stripped without destroying the value of the interviews.

value: Active citizens in the municipalities of Nijmegen and Apeldoorn, who are designated spokespersons for community-based initiatives.

fields.value: Many respondents were very busy and at certain times of the year or during the COVID pandemic not eager to talk to yet anonther social scientist.
only 4 people did not want to participate in the second round of interviews of 22 people in the first round
